Year 7 Entry September 2027
For parents/carers and students who are considering joining us in Year 7 in September 2027, please come along to one of our many Open Events to meet our passionate team of educators, discover our ambitious and broad curriculum and experience first-hand our vibrant and exciting learning community.
This year we have an Open Morning on Saturday 10th October from 10.00am until 1pm, no booking is necessary for this event to allow families to visit the school together at a time convenient for them.
We also are also open to visitors each Tuesday morning during term time from Tuesday 15th September until 20th October 2026, tours begin promptly at 9.15am until 10.45am.
Due to demand and the school being fully operational at these times, we are operating ticket only admission to these sessions.
Tickets can be booked here: https://bit.ly/433oFcW
